items.q: Have you been walking in the rain?
items.a: Yes, I have been walking in the rain.

items.q: Have you been listening to the radio?
Have you been doing your homework?
Have you been reading a book?
Have you been brushing your hair?
Have you been taking a shower?
Have you been observing the landscape?
Have you been sleeping in your bed?
Have you been operating your computer?
What have you been doing today?

blocks.text: Now, write sentences in Past perfect continuous…

items: I had been postponing my work.
How long had you been walking in the rain? (2 hours) — _I had been walking in the rain for two hours._
How long had you been listening to the radio? (3 hours) — _I had been listening to the radio for three hours._
How long had you been observing the landscape? (4 hours) — _I had been observing the landscape for four hours._
How long had you been operating your computer? (4 hours) — _I had been operating my computer for four hours._

items.q: How long had you been practicing these exercises? (for days)
How long had you been learning English grammar? (for months)
How long had you been waiting for the exam? (a month)
How long had you been looking for a new job? (two weeks)

items: He had ______ fishing in the lake.
It had ______ raining all night long.
We had ______ complaining for this service.
They had ______ doing exactly what they wanted.
